scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Creative Art
other_conditions: Nominee must be a winner of national or international acclaim for contribution to literature, theatre, cinema, music, dance, painting, sculpture, photography, etc.
Nominee must continue to be active in their artistic field well into old age
Nominee must have exemplary contribution in the field of art, with social messages on contemporary issues
Nominee must have outstanding achievement in promotion and dissemination of art and be widely recognized
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized person; self‑nominations are not considered
Open to all Indian institutions, organizations and individuals without discrimination on religion, race, sex, caste or creed
benefits_summary: Award includes a citation, a memento and a cash prize of ₹2,50,000, with travel, lodging and per‑diem expenses for the awardee and one companion covered by the Government.
